ourQualities.title: QUALITY FOOD
ourQualities.description: We use fresh ingredients and maintain strict standards to ensure healthy, high-quality meals.

ourQualities.title: SUPER TASTE
ourQualities.description: Every dish is crafted with balanced flavors to deliver rich taste and lasting satisfaction.

ourQualities.title: FAST DELIVERY
ourQualities.description: Our efficient delivery system ensures your food arrives hot, fresh, and on time.

menuItems.title: Coffee
menuItems.description: Freshly brewed premium coffee made from the finest coffee beans, served hot with a rich aroma and smooth taste.

menuItems.title: Pancake
menuItems.description: Fluffy golden pancakes served with maple syrup, butter, and fresh berries. A perfect start to your day.

menuItems.title: Ruti Bhaji
menuItems.description: Traditional Bengali breakfast with soft roti and flavorful mixed vegetables, cooked with aromatic spices.

menuItems.title: Stuffed Strawberry
menuItems.description: Fresh strawberries stuffed with a creamy vanilla filling and drizzled with dark chocolate sauce.

menuItems.title: Chicken Biriyani
menuItems.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with tender chicken pieces, aromatic spices, and herbs. Served with raita and salad.

menuItems.title: Chicken Curry
menuItems.description: Tender chicken pieces cooked in a rich, spicy curry with onions, tomatoes, and traditional spices. Served with rice or roti.

menuItems.title: Dal Bhat
menuItems.description: Traditional lentil curry served with steamed rice, a staple comfort food that's both nutritious and delicious.

menuItems.title: Egg Curry
menuItems.description: Hard-boiled eggs cooked in a flavorful curry with onions, tomatoes, and aromatic spices. Perfect with rice or roti.

menuItems.title: Kacchi
menuItems.description: Premium mutton biriyani cooked with raw marinated meat and basmati rice, slow-cooked to perfection with aromatic spices.

menuItems.title: Mach Bhat
menuItems.description: Traditional fish curry with rice, a Bengali favorite featuring fresh fish cooked in a tangy and spicy gravy.

menuItems.title: Mutton Curry
menuItems.description: Tender mutton pieces slow-cooked in a rich, spicy curry with traditional spices. Served with rice or naan.

menuItems.title: Shorshe Ilish
menuItems.description: Hilsa fish cooked in a mustard-based curry, a signature Bengali dish known for its unique flavor and aroma.

menuItems.title: Roasted Lamb Rump
menuItems.description: Slow-roasted lamb rump seasoned with garlic, rosemary, and herbs, served with buttery mashed potatoes and seasonal vegetables.

menuItems.title: Citrus Cured Salmon
menuItems.description: Fresh salmon cured with lemon and orange zest, topped with microgreens and served with a light citrus dressing.

menuItems.title: Mussels Soup
menuItems.description: Rich and aromatic soup made with fresh mussels, white wine, garlic, and herbs, served with toasted bread.

menuItems.title: Grilled Fish
menuItems.description: Marinated fish fillet grilled over an open flame, served with roasted vegetables and lemon wedges.

menuItems.title: Pan Seared Sea Bass
menuItems.description: Delicate sea bass fillet pan seared to perfection, paired with sautéed greens and a zesty lemon butter sauce.

menuItems.title: Burger
menuItems.description: Juicy beef patty with fresh lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and special sauce in a toasted bun. Served with crispy fries.

menuItems.title: French Fries
menuItems.description: Crispy golden french fries, perfectly seasoned and served hot. A classic side dish that pairs with everything.

menuItems.title: Fried Chicken
menuItems.description: Crispy fried chicken pieces marinated in special spices, deep-fried to golden perfection. Served with dipping sauce.

menuItems.title: Fuchka
menuItems.description: Crispy hollow puris filled with spiced mashed potatoes, chickpeas, and tangy tamarind water. A popular street food favorite.

menuItems.title: Hotdog
menuItems.description: Classic hotdog with grilled sausage in a soft bun, topped with mustard, ketchup, onions, and relish.

menuItems.title: Pizza
menuItems.description: Wood-fired pizza with fresh mozzarella, premium toppings, and our signature tomato sauce on a crispy thin crust.

menuItems.title: Sub Sandwich
menuItems.description: Fresh sub sandwich loaded with your choice of meats, cheese, fresh vegetables, and condiments in a soft roll.

menuItems.title: Italian Spaghetti
menuItems.description: Classic Italian spaghetti tossed in a slow-cooked tomato and basil sauce, finished with parmesan cheese.

menuItems.title: Beef Burger Meal
menuItems.description: Juicy grilled beef burger with cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato, and house sauce, served with crispy fries and a drink.
